issues.quote: The human plateau began to shift.
Posts flew across feeds like hotcakes
Two hundred thousand viewers instantly jumped to two hundred and fifty.
Online media bots picked up on the event and began churning out stories
Questions like that Freya now left unanswered.
But fame comes with responsibility—the questions took a sharp turn toward the genre of a collective Tinder date.
